correct_sentence: Knowledge is true power.
arabic_translation: المعرفة هي القوة الحقيقية.
strategy_ar: الأسماء المجردة (Knowledge, Power) لا تأخذ 'a/an' أو 's'. الصفة true قبل الاسم power.
explanation_ar: Knowledge اسم مجرد (لا يُعدّ)، لذا لا a/an. true (صفة) قبل power (اسم).
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'The knowledge is a true power' - لا داعي لـ the أو a مع الأسماء المجردة.
hint_ar: Knowledge + is + true + power (صفة قبل اسم).

correct_sentence: Reading books expands your mind.
arabic_translation: قراءة الكتب توسّع عقلك.
strategy_ar: Gerund (فعل + ing) يمكن أن يكون فاعلاً للجملة. Reading books = القراءة كنشاط.
explanation_ar: Reading (gerund/فاعل) + books + expands (فعل، لاحظ s لأن الفاعل مفرد مجازياً) + your mind.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'Read books expands' - يجب gerund (Reading) عند البدء بفعل كفاعل.
hint_ar: Reading (V-ing كفاعل) + books + expands + your + mind.

correct_sentence: She decided to study abroad next year.
arabic_translation: قررت أن تدرس في الخارج العام القادم.
strategy_ar: بعض الأفعال (decide, want, plan) تتبع بـ to + فعل مجرد. الزمن (next year) في النهاية.
explanation_ar: She + decided + to study (infinitive) + abroad (ظرف مكان) + next year (زمن).
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'decided studying' - بعد decide نستخدم to + فعل، وليس gerund.
hint_ar: decided + to + study، abroad، next year في النهاية.

correct_sentence: The meeting was postponed until Friday.
arabic_translation: تم تأجيل الاجتماع حتى يوم الجمعة.
strategy_ar: المبني للمجهول: was/were + V3. The meeting (لا يفعل بل يُفعَل به).
explanation_ar: The meeting + was (مساعد) + postponed (V3) + until + Friday. الفاعل الحقيقي مجهول/غير مهم.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'The meeting postponed' - يجب was/were مع المبني للمجهول.
hint_ar: was + postponed (مبني للمجهول)، until Friday.

correct_sentence: He works hard despite his illness.
arabic_translation: يعمل بجد رغم مرضه.
strategy_ar: despite يتبع باسم أو ضمير (وليس جملة كاملة). للتعبير عن التضاد.
explanation_ar: He + works hard (الفعل الرئيسي) + despite his illness (رغم اسم). despite ليس despite that.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'despite he is ill' - بعد despite يجب اسم وليس جملة. الجملة تحتاج although.
hint_ar: despite + his + illness (اسم بعده مباشرة).

correct_sentence: The book which I bought yesterday was expensive.
arabic_translation: الكتاب الذي اشتريته أمس كان غالياً.
strategy_ar: which للأشياء (وليس للأشخاص). الجملة الموصولية تأتي بعد الاسم مباشرة.
explanation_ar: The book (الاسم) + which I bought yesterday (وصف) + was expensive (الخبر). which للأشياء.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'The book who I bought' - who للأشخاص، which للأشياء.
hint_ar: The + book + which + I + bought + yesterday، ثم was + expensive.

correct_sentence: Not only did he win but also broke records.
arabic_translation: ليس فقط فاز بل أيضاً حطّم الأرقام القياسية.
strategy_ar: بعد Not only في بداية الجملة يحدث inversion: did + فاعل + فعل مجرد.
explanation_ar: Not only + did + he + win (تركيب معكوس) + but also + broke + records. تركيب أكاديمي للتأكيد.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'Not only he won' - بعد Not only يجب inversion: did he win.
hint_ar: Not only + did + he + win، ثم but + also + broke + records.

correct_sentence: Had I known earlier, I would have helped.
arabic_translation: لو كنت أعلم في وقت أبكر، لكنت ساعدت.
strategy_ar: الشرط من النوع الثالث المعكوس: Had + فاعل + V3، ثم would have + V3.
explanation_ar: Had I known (بدلاً من If I had known) + I would have helped. تركيب رسمي للأسف.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'Had I knew' - بعد Had يجب V3 (known) وليس V2 (knew).
hint_ar: Had + I + known + earlier، ثم I + would + have + helped.

correct_sentence: The article was written by a famous scientist.
arabic_translation: كُتب المقال بواسطة عالم مشهور.
strategy_ar: المبني للمجهول: be + V3 + by + الفاعل. famous (صفة) قبل scientist.
explanation_ar: The article (الموضوع) + was written (مبني للمجهول) + by (الأداة) + a famous scientist (الفاعل الحقيقي).
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'written from' - الفاعل في المبني للمجهول يأتي بعد 'by' وليس 'from'.
hint_ar: was + written + by + a + famous + scientist (صفة قبل اسم).

correct_sentence: Despite working hard, she failed the final exam.
arabic_translation: رغم عملها الجاد، رسبت في الامتحان النهائي.
strategy_ar: Despite + V-ing (gerund) + ، + جملة كاملة. final قبل exam (صفة قبل اسم).
explanation_ar: Despite + working hard (gerund phrase) + she failed + the final exam. لا تنسَ الفاصلة.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'Despite she worked hard' - بعد despite gerund أو اسم، وليس جملة.
hint_ar: Despite + working + hard، ثم she + failed + the + final + exam.

correct_sentence: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the test.
arabic_translation: لو كنت درست بجد أكثر، لكنت نجحت في الاختبار.
strategy_ar: If + had + V3 (الماضي التام)، would have + V3. للأسف على ما حدث.
explanation_ar: If I had studied harder (شرط ماضٍ مستحيل) + I would have passed (نتيجة افتراضية).
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'If I would have studied' - بعد If لا تستخدم would، استخدم had + V3.
hint_ar: If + I + had + studied + harder، ثم I + would + have + passed + the + test.

correct_sentence: The professor whose research won the prize teaches our class.
arabic_translation: البروفيسور الذي فاز بحثه بالجائزة يدرّس صفنا.
strategy_ar: whose يستخدم للملكية. The professor whose research = البروفيسور الذي بحثه...
explanation_ar: The professor (الموصوف) + whose research won the prize (جملة وصفية بالملكية) + teaches our class.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'The professor who his research' - استخدم whose للملكية وليس who his.
hint_ar: professor + whose + research + won + the + prize، ثم teaches + our + class.

correct_sentence: Although the weather was terrible, we enjoyed our trip very much.
arabic_translation: رغم أن الطقس كان فظيعاً، استمتعنا برحلتنا كثيراً.
strategy_ar: Although يتبع بجملة كاملة (عكس despite الذي يتبع باسم). فاصلة قبل الجملة الثانية.
explanation_ar: Although + the weather was terrible (جملة كاملة) + we enjoyed (الجملة الرئيسية) + very much (تأكيد).
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'Although terrible weather' - بعد although جملة كاملة بفاعل وفعل.
hint_ar: Although + the + weather + was + terrible، ثم we + enjoyed + our + trip + very + much.

correct_sentence: The more you practice English, the better your skills will become.
arabic_translation: كلما تدربت أكثر على الإنجليزية، كلما تحسّنت مهاراتك.
strategy_ar: تركيب 'كلما ... كلما': The + comparative + جملة، the + comparative + جملة.
explanation_ar: The more (مقارنة 1) + you practice English، the better (مقارنة 2) + your skills will become.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'More you practice, more better' - يجب the قبل كل comparative، وbetter ليس more better.
hint_ar: The + more + you + practice + English، ثم the + better + your + skills + will + become.

correct_sentence: Scientists have discovered that exercise improves both physical and mental health.
arabic_translation: اكتشف العلماء أن التمارين تحسّن الصحة الجسدية والعقلية معاً.
strategy_ar: Scientists have discovered (مضارع تام) + that (رابط) + جملة. both A and B (كلا ... و).
explanation_ar: Scientists + have discovered + that + exercise improves + both + physical + and + mental + health.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'both physical mental' - يجب 'both physical and mental' (and ضرورية).
hint_ar: have + discovered + that، exercise + improves، both + physical + and + mental + health.

correct_sentence: It is essential that every student submit the assignment before the deadline.
arabic_translation: من الضروري أن يسلّم كل طالب الواجب قبل الموعد النهائي.
strategy_ar: بعد It is essential/important that نستخدم الفعل بصيغة المصدر (مجرد) حتى مع he/she/it.
explanation_ar: It is essential that every student + submit (وليس submits!) + the assignment + before the deadline.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'every student submits' - في الـ subjunctive الفعل يبقى مجرداً بدون s.
hint_ar: It + is + essential + that + every + student + submit (بدون s) + the + assignment + before + the + deadline.

correct_sentence: Researchers found that students who read regularly perform better in school.
arabic_translation: وجد الباحثون أن الطلاب الذين يقرؤون بانتظام يؤدّون بشكل أفضل في المدرسة.
strategy_ar: بنية أكاديمية: Researchers found that + جملة. مع who كجملة وصفية للطلاب.
explanation_ar: Researchers found that + students (الموصوف) + who read regularly (وصفهم) + perform better in school.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'students which read' - مع الأشخاص نستخدم who وليس which.
hint_ar: Researchers + found + that، students + who + read + regularly، perform + better + in + school.

correct_sentence: Not only does technology save time but it also creates new job opportunities.
arabic_translation: التكنولوجيا لا توفّر الوقت فقط بل تخلق فرص عمل جديدة أيضاً.
strategy_ar: Not only + does/do (inversion) + فاعل + فعل، but + فاعل + also + فعل.
explanation_ar: Not only does technology save time (inversion) + but it also creates new job opportunities. new قبل job قبل opportunities.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'Not only technology saves' - بعد Not only يجب does/do + فاعل + فعل مجرد.
hint_ar: Not + only + does + technology + save + time، but + it + also + creates + new + job + opportunities.

correct_sentence: The committee recommended that the new policy be implemented as soon as possible.
arabic_translation: أوصت اللجنة بتنفيذ السياسة الجديدة في أقرب وقت ممكن.
strategy_ar: بعد recommend/suggest that نستخدم be + V3 (subjunctive passive). as soon as possible = في أسرع وقت.
explanation_ar: The committee recommended that + the new policy + be (subjunctive) + implemented + as soon as possible.
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'should be implemented' - في الـ subjunctive لا نحتاج should بعد recommended that.
hint_ar: recommended + that، the + new + policy + be + implemented، as + soon + as + possible.

correct_sentence: Had the government invested more in education, the country would have prospered economically.
arabic_translation: لو استثمرت الحكومة أكثر في التعليم، لازدهرت البلاد اقتصادياً.
strategy_ar: Had + فاعل + V3 (بدلاً من If had) + would have + V3. تركيب رسمي للندم على ماضٍ.
explanation_ar: Had the government invested more in education (شرط معكوس) + the country would have prospered economically (نتيجة).
common_error_ar: خطأ شائع: 'If the government had invested' صحيح لكن الـ inversion 'Had the government invested' أكثر أكاديمية.
hint_ar: Had + the + government + invested + more + in + education، the + country + would + have + prospered + economically.
